meta.title: Vigil for Windows
meta.description: A small screen on your desk with the time, your PC’s vital signs and the weather. Vigil runs it quietly from the tray.
meta.shortDescription: A small screen on your desk with the time, your PC’s vital signs and the weather.
meta.imageAlt: Vigil’s clock view on a 3.5-inch USB screen, next to the words “Keeps watch.”

hero.title: Keeps watch.
hero.lead: A small screen on your desk with the time, your PC’s vital signs and the weather. Vigil runs it quietly from the tray, from the moment Windows starts.
hero.fineprint: Windows 10 and 11 · 64-bit · No administrator rights needed
hero.source: Free and open source on GitHub
hero.screenLabel: Vigil’s clock view on the USB screen: the time and date, with CPU and GPU temperature, memory and download speed along the bottom
hero.caption: The clock view on a 3.5-inch USB screen, 480 × 320 pixels. Readings are illustrative.

statement.label: What Vigil is for
statement.text: A screen that never asks for your attention. It simply has the answer when you look.

views.title:
Four views.
Taking turns.
views.lead: Keep one on screen, or let them rotate on their own through the day.
views.clockText: Big, calm digits you can read from across the room.
views.systemText: Temperatures, load, memory, disk, network and volume, live.
views.weatherText: The sky outside, with a quote of the day beneath it.
views.worldText: The cities you care about, at a glance.

designs.title:
Six designs.
Six personalities.
designs.lead: The system view comes in six looks, each with colours you can change. Same sensors. Different mood.

sensors.title: Everything your PC feels.
sensors.diskText: How full it is, and its temperature
sensors.note: A note on CPU temperature: Windows only shares it with programs that have administrator rights and a driver. Turn on CPU temperature in Vigil’s System settings and install the free PawnIO driver. Without them, Vigil shows the CPU’s load instead.

quiet.title: Starts with Windows. Then gets out of the way.
quiet.startText: Vigil starts with Windows and drives the screen before you open anything.
quiet.trayText: It waits in the notification area. Settings are one click away.
quiet.browserText: Vigil talks to the screen directly over USB. Nothing to keep open.
quiet.updatesText: Run the new installer over the old one. Your settings stay put.

privacy.title: Online for one thing only.
privacy.text: The weather. Vigil asks Open-Meteo about the city you pick, with your position rounded to about a kilometre. Your sensors never leave your PC.

cta.title:
Give your desk
a pulse.
